newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-RED SOX' CORDERO ACCUSED OF BEATING WIFE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-RED SOX' CORDERO ACCUSED OF BEATING WIFE.

text.p: Left fielder Wilfredo Cordero of the Boston Red Sox was arrested Wednesday after allegedly beating his wife while he was intoxicated.
Cambridge police arrested Cordero on charges of assault and battery. Cordero's wife declined to press charges.
"Any situation we have involving a baseball player with the Red Sox, we will take care of it in here," Red Sox manager Jimy Williams said in a show of support.
Red Sox general manager Dan Duquette added: "What's important is that we work with Wil and his wife to resolve this problem."
Duquette and Williams declined to say when Cordero, who is in his second season with the Sox, would return to the lineup. Nor would they say if there will be a suspension.
Cordero, batting .296 with 10 homers and 36 runs batted in, was not in the starting lineup for Wednesday night's game against the Baltimore Orioles.
Cordero was brought to the police station early Wednesday morning and released on $1,000 cash bail about an hour later. A pretrial hearing was set for July 24.
Anna, who declined to testify against her husband, left the courtroom holding hands with him.
